name: Hockenheimring (Original Layout)
summary: The old Hockenheim: flat-out runs into the forest and back into a packed stadium.
character: Long straights through the forest broken up by chicanes, then a slow, twisty stadium section. Engines spent long stretches at full throttle.

moments.title: Barrichello wins from 18th
moments.body: In 2000 Rubens Barrichello started 18th, stayed on dry tyres when rain fell on part of the track, and won his first Grand Prix.

history.body: First German Grand Prix at Hockenheim.
Became the German GP's regular home after F1 left the Nordschleife.
Rebuilt as a shorter 4.574 km layout, raced on and off until 2019.

leftCalendar: The forest section was cut in 2002 for a shorter track with more grandstands. That newer layout hosted the German Grand Prix on and off until 2019.
